tools.name: search_employers
tools.description: Find employers with Form 5500 health and welfare filings. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Returns up to 100 matches, largest first, with carriers, brokers, premium, comp rate, funding and renewal month. Union and multiple-employer plans are excluded unless include_union is true.

tools.name: get_employer
tools.description: One employer by EIN: every Schedule A contract (carrier, lines, premium, covered lives, commissions and fees, comp rate, broker), plans with links to the original filing PDFs, and plan-year history back to 2019 (participants, premium, funding, carriers, brokers).

tools.name: get_broker
tools.description: A brokerage firm's book from Form 5500 filings: employers, participants, premium placed, commissions and fees, comp rate, top states and carriers, group sizes, recent broker-of-record wins and losses, largest employers. Firms with 5+ employers only; individual agents aren't covered.

tools.name: get_carrier
tools.description: An insurance carrier's group business from Form 5500 filings: employers, premium, covered lives, lines, top states, brokers placing it, median comp rate, largest employers; plus its fully insured small- and large-group market share, 3-year MLR and rebates owed by state from CMS Medical Loss Ratio da

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Employee benefits market in one state: employers, participants, premium, funding mix, top medical carriers, top brokers, renewal months, median comp rate, largest employers; plus fully insured small- and large-group market share, 3-year MLR and rebates owed by carrier from CMS Medical Loss Ratio dat

tools.name: get_benchmarks
tools.description: Broker comp-rate benchmarks (median, 25th and 75th percentile of commissions + fees as a share of premium) and median premium per covered life per month, by line of coverage and group size.
